cards.text: Ahab, king of Israel, just died in battle at Ramoth-gilead, and Jehoshaphat, king of Judah, rode into that battle right beside him (1 Kings 22:29, 35). Jehoshaphat is the son of Asa, and he became king of Judah in the fourth year of Ahab's reign over Israel.
He's thirty-five when he becomes king, and he reigns twenty-five years. His mother's name is Azubah daughter of Shilhi.

cards.question: For twenty-five years, Jehoshaphat reigns as king of Judah in ___.
Whose ways does Jehoshaphat walk in, without ever turning away from them?
Jehoshaphat walks in his father Asa's ways. He does what is ___ in the eyes of the LORD.

cards.text: A GOOD KING! I hopped so high on this gold base the whole jar of sprinkles went flying. But the high places are not removed.

cards.question: With the high places still standing, the people still sacrifice and burn incense on them.

cards.text: Next up: Jehoshaphat and the king of Israel, his neighbor to the north. Remember, Jehoshaphat just rode into battle beside Israel's king.

cards.question: Judah and Israel sit side by side, and their kings just fought together. How do things go between Jehoshaphat and the king of Israel?

answers.text: Jehoshaphat refuses to speak to him

cards.text: The rest of his acts, the might he exercised and how he waged war, are written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah.
And Jehoshaphat isn't done cleaning house. Some people were still in the land from the days of his father Asa.

cards.question: Jehoshaphat lets the male shrine prostitutes left over from his father Asa's days stay in the land.

cards.text: Over in Edom, there's no king, just a deputy serving as king. Back in Judah, Jehoshaphat builds ships of Tarshish to sail to Ophir.

cards.question: Jehoshaphat's ships of Tarshish are headed to Ophir. What are they going there to get?
Jehoshaphat's ships of Tarshish never get past Ezion-geber. What happens to them there?

cards.text: I KNOW that feeling, friend. You mix the dough, preheat the oven, and the whole tray slides off the counter before it ever sees the heat.
At that time, Ahaziah son of Ahab, who took his father's place as king of Israel (1 Kings 22:40), says to Jehoshaphat, "Let my servants sail with your servants," and waits for an answer.

cards.question: Jehoshaphat agrees to let Ahaziah's servants sail with his servants.

cards.text: He says no. Then Jehoshaphat rests with his fathers, and his son Jehoram reigns in his place.

cards.question: Jehoshaphat is buried with his fathers in the city of his father ___.

cards.text: Now back up north, where Ahaziah becomes king of Israel in the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat's reign over Judah, and he reigns in Samaria two years. His father Ahab did more to provoke the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger than all the kings of Israel before him (1 Kings 16:33).

cards.question: Ahaziah does evil in the sight of the LORD.

cards.text: He walks in the ways of his father and mother, and of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who had caused Israel to sin.

cards.question: Just as his father had done, Ahaziah serves and worships ___, provoking the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger.
